metadata.name: Clipboard Bridge
metadata.description: Share text, photos and files between Windows, Android and Apple Shortcuts over a trusted local network or private VPN. The standalone server provides a browser interface, persistent shared history, grouped files and optional isolated accounts. No mandatory cloud account is required. Optional token/account URL values are readable and HTTP is not encrypted; do not publish this service directly to the internet.
metadata.tagline: A private clipboard and file bridge across your devices
metadata.author: Mattboxx

environment_variables.name: CLIPBOARD_PORT
environment_variables.description: Internal web/API port; keep consistent with the container port and healthcheck

environment_variables.name: CLIPBOARD_DATA_DIR
environment_variables.description: Persistent data directory inside the container

environment_variables.name: CLIPBOARD_MAX_UPLOAD_MB
environment_variables.description: Maximum size of a complete upload request in MB

environment_variables.name: CLIPBOARD_TOKEN
environment_variables.description: Optional shared API token; empty leaves the general API open

environment_variables.name: CLIPBOARD_PASSWORD
environment_variables.description: Optional general web password; does not by itself protect the API

environment_variables.name: CLIPBOARD_ACCOUNTS
environment_variables.description: Optional isolated accounts: user:password pairs separated by commas

environment_variables.name: CLIPBOARD_SESSION_DAYS
environment_variables.description: Remembered browser login duration, 1 to 3650 days

volumes.description: History, uploaded files, accounts file if used, and persistent session key

before_install.en_us: Use a trusted LAN or private VPN. Authentication is optional: empty settings leave the general shared clipboard open. Isolated accounts protect only their own spaces; adding accounts does not protect the general shared clipboard. To protect the general web page and API, set both CLIPBOARD_PASSWORD and CLIPBOARD_TOKEN. The web password alone does not protect the general API. URL credentials are readable; HTTP is not encrypted. Do not forward port 5088 on your router. Keep the /data volume when updating.
